dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Cervical spinal cord lesion (longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis) causing secondary segmental dystonia (cervical dystonia with laterocollis and rotacollis)
Alternative 1: Neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD) presenting as longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis
Alternative 2: Idiopathic adult-onset cervical dystonia with incidental asymptomatic cervical spinal cord signal abnormality
